gap: pc_fold only removes whole earlier tokens. Two adjacent valid matches may have a movable boundary even where whole-token folding is blocked by a mismatching prefix or the 258-byte cap. Existing source comments mention generic PARTIAL, but current PC has no partial operation; searches of round reports/builders found no executed direct PC suffix-boundary experiment.
substantive_change: Reuse the two existing distances and token count. Move a suffix from the previous match into the current match only when its bytes match the current distance, both resulting lengths remain legal, and the frozen original block's known length-code prices strictly decrease. No new match search, distance selection, parser route, lazy/depth sweep, or changed encoder.
minimum_operation: On the exact combo parent, collect real row entry and original tokens. For active PC rows only, scan adjacent match pairs within the same original 16384-token block. Examine left-boundary shifts up to min(previous_length-3, 258-current_length, current_start-current_distance). Choose minimum known old-block length-code cost, smallest shift on ties; leave unknown codes unavailable. Encode original and rewritten streams with the pinned encoder and independently decode both.
decision: A negligible or negative actual byte gain pauses this exact boundary rule without proof or timing. A material gain merits a cheaper online approximation or one bounded native implementation, with its real parser/encoder total time tested. Local bit savings and available shifts alone cannot promote it.
cost_cap: One native untimed diagnostic; compile 240 seconds, run 240 seconds enforced. Original block price construction is diagnostic overhead and is not assumed free in any eventual candidate.
proof_interface: Any eventual online implementation must preserve a valid decoded prefix while shortening an already emitted match, preserve its original distance and match prefix, prove transferred suffix match, and use mutable output in a new fold helper. Existing read-only PC.fold result cannot directly prove this; fresh extraction and original full gate would be needed.
scope: Final token replay can bound an opportunity on this frozen parse, not guarantee the online parser's later fold trajectory or performance. Missing original Huffman codes remain UNKNOWN rather than zero-priced.
